Commitlint/commit-convention finding: bun install auto-installs lefthook hooks (lefthook 2.x postinstall), and stock @commitlint/config-conventional rejects a leading [CTX-XXXX] banner. Local commit subjects therefore stay conventional with the task suffix, e.g. 'chore(bootstrap): initialize activity plugin repository (CTX-0001)'; PR/squash titles may still carry the [CTX-XXXX] prefix. Recorded for follow-up if a repo-wide header rule is desired.

Mock host does not validate UTF-8 (tests/support/mock_host.lua:50-83); redact_spec.lua:37-38 checks byte length only. Fix: UTF-8-boundary truncation + validity assertion.
